title: Set up with us, within 48 hours
lead: We do the setup with you, so you are never figuring it out alone.

steps.title: Book a demo
steps.body: A 30-minute call at a time that suits you. We show you how Yawmy Care fits your nursery's day.

steps.title: We set it up with you
steps.body: Within 48 hours, we set up your nursery around the way you already work.

steps.title: Invite your team and parents
steps.body: Invite your teachers and staff, then parents. Everyone is connected in one app.

steps.title: Start your first day
steps.body: Attendance, messages and daily reports, together from day one.
